status: Bank-specific scenario estimates using shared macro v1; regulatory threshold 13% corroborated by the September 2026 BoG Monetary Policy Report; not investment advice.

anchor.method: Use the observed September 2026 balance sheet and year-to-date earnings. Q4 is estimated from the 9M run rate with a scenario multiplier. 9M gross loans and allowance are not disclosed: the anchor gross, RWA and capital use the BASE net-to-gross estimate (82%, an explicit estimated improvement over the actual FY2025 77.93%), then treat allowance = gross - net as an estimate. No historical imputation.

loan_growth.method: 2027 onward nominal GDP approximation = shared real GDP growth + CPI inflation, plus a bank-specific spread in percentage points; 2026 Q4 net-loan growth applied to the September actual. Annual growth capped/floored at -10% and 35%.
loan_growth.reason: Gross loans fell from 9,390.373m (FY2024) to 9,820.519m (FY2025) then net loans 7,652.776m -> 9,027.632m at 9M-2026; assume a return to nominal-GDP-linked growth rather than trend extrapolation.

deposit_growth.method: Nominal GDP approximation plus spread; 2026 Q4 from the September deposit balance.
deposit_growth.reason: FY2025 customer deposits 24,013.184m; September 2026 29,292.992m, a strong inflow. Assume growth normalises toward nominal GDP.

investment_yield.method: Diagnostic only, NOT used in the income forecast: 50% shared 364-day T-bill and 50% medium-term government bond yield, reported as x_investment_yield_pct for context.
investment_yield.reason: Income uses the blended anchor-implied yield (see blended_asset_yield); this row is retained as a reference for the securities mix.

blended_asset_yield.method: Interest income / mean earning assets (cash+BoG, investment securities, net loans), carried forward for continuity and drifted by the shared policy-rate ratio. Earning assets use the prior-year cash balance as a proxy because the current cash residual is only known after equity is set.
blended_asset_yield.reason: Avoids the method-switch jump flagged by review; back-tested on FY2024->FY2025 with a 4.3% error. The FY2024 implied earning-asset yield applied to FY2025 average earning assets predicts FY2025 interest income of 3,563.0m versus the actual 3,415.7m. The anchor-implied asset yield (9M-2026 annualised) is about 7.0%.
blended_asset_yield.note: The cash and BoG residual includes non-earning reserve balances; the blended yield is a portfolio average, not an eligible-reserve rate. Inter-bank balances are not given a separate income line.

blended_cost_of_funds.method: Interest expense / mean interest-bearing funding (customer deposits, due to banks, borrowings), carried forward and drifted by the shared policy-rate ratio.
blended_cost_of_funds.reason: FY2024 implied funding cost 2.6% applied to FY2025 average funding predicted FY2025 interest expense of 663.8m versus the actual 578.9m; the blended method is continuous with the anchor.
blended_cost_of_funds.note: Effective blended cost, not a quoted deposit rate.

fee_growth.method: Shared nominal GDP proxy plus spread; preserve the fee expense/income ratio unless stress applied.
fee_growth.reason: Fee and commission revenue grew from 700.025m (FY2024) to 771.076m (FY2025).

trading_growth_spread_pp.method: Trading revenue and other gains grow with the nominal GDP proxy plus a scenario spread.
trading_growth_spread_pp.reason: Trading revenue is a large and volatile line (591.788m FY2024 -> 1,011.641m FY2025).

opex_growth.method: Shared CPI inflation plus a percentage-point spread.
opex_growth.reason: Staff and other operating expenses grew sharply in FY2025; inflation plus a growth-related overhead is a transparent sensitivity, not guidance.

cost_of_risk.method: Loan impairment charge / average gross loans; scenario percentage. No repeat of the FY2022 DDEP/credit event assumed. Floor modelled impairment at the increase in allowance stock to prevent an unfunded allowance build.
cost_of_risk.reason: FY2022 credit impairment was 965.937m; FY2023-FY2025 fell to 31.876m / 364.191m / 52.178m. 9M-2026 charge 102.757m against gross loans near 9,800m annualises to about 1.4%. Base reflects a normalisation from a low base, near the reported loan-loss ratio.

npl_pct.method: 2026 year-end based on the reported 9M 9.54%; subsequent scenario target, not a forecast from loan-level data.

net_to_gross_pct.method: Net loans = gross loans x net-to-gross ratio. For the forecast, net loans grow by the loan-growth driver and gross = net / net-to-gross; the loan_loss_allowance stock is then gross minus net (which folds in any interest in suspense on the same basis as the FY2025 filing). FY2026E starts from the actual 9M net loans. The anchor gross/RWA/capital use the BASE net-to-gross (82%), not the actual FY2025 77.93%; this is an explicit estimated improvement, not a reported figure. Sensitivity: a lower anchor ratio raises opening gross loans, RWA and the Q4 allowance build.
net_to_gross_pct.reason: FY2025 reported net 7,652.776m / gross 9,820.519m = 77.93% (allowance 1,502.630m + interest in suspense 665.113m = 22.07% of gross). The interim reports a lower NPL (9.54% vs FY2025 24.63%), so the base ratio rises modestly as the loan book seasons; the downside keeps a heavier deduction.

tax_rate_pct.method: Effective total tax (indirect + direct) on positive PBT; no automatic deferred tax benefit for losses.
tax_rate_pct.reason: FY2025 total tax 998.865/2,607.532 = 38.3%; 9M-2026 501.929/1,405.714 = 35.7%; FY2024 34.5%. 25% corporate rate plus levies. Forecast uses a blended 37%; future levy law changes not assumed.

indirect_tax_ratio_pct.method: Indirect tax expressed as a share of PBT for the forecast split only; not additive to the total tax.
indirect_tax_ratio_pct.reason: FY2025 indirect tax 78.313m / PBT 2,607.532m = 3.0%; 9M-2026 2.58%. Use 3% of PBT as the reported indirect-tax estimate; the remainder of `income_tax` is the direct tax.

dividend_payout_pct.method: Payout on positive PAT; constrained if a capital target, cash minimum or distributable retained earnings is breached.
dividend_payout_pct.reason: FY2022 dividend 180.000m on a loss (prior-year profit); 9M-2026 dividends paid 1,126.334m. Scenario payout sensitivity.

statutory_reserve_transfer_pct.method: Annual transfer from retained earnings to the statutory reserve, as a share of POSITIVE FULL-YEAR PAT, less any statutory transfer already made year-to-date. An internal equity transfer, so total equity and regulatory capital are unaffected; it caps distributable retained earnings for dividends.
statutory_reserve_transfer_pct.reason: Source-confirmed: FY2024 transfer 145.325m = 12.5% x PAT 1,162.602m; FY2025 201.083m = 12.5% x PAT 1,608.667m (SB24AR/SB25AR note 16.1). The 9M-2026 equity statement shows the statutory reserve unchanged at 1,026.642m since January, so the actual YTD statutory transfer is zero (the 212.987m credit-risk-reserve transfer is a DISTINCT line, tracked separately and not netted). Illustrative FY2026E transfer: base 1170.626 x 12.5% = 146.328m; downside 213.209 x 12.5% = 26.651m; upside 1311.620 x 12.5% = 163.953m. Later years keep the annual positive-PAT rule.

capital_ratio_target_pct.method: Management buffer (percentage points) above the shared minimum CAR, not an official target; RWA intensity calibrated from the FY2025 audited RWA / assets, then independently flag any minimum shortfall.
capital_ratio_target_pct.reason: FY2025 regulatory capital 4,011.995m / RWA 17,314.504m = 23.2%; 9M-2026 reported CAR 23.32% but no interim RWA/capital breakdown.

q4_income_runrate_multiplier.method: Scale Q4 revenues by the scenario multiplier; Q4 funding expenses multiplied by 1.25 downside / 0.9 upside / 1 base, OPEX 1.10 downside / 1 base / 1 upside, and Q4 risk charge by estimated gross loans and scenario risk / 4; keep the actual 9M flows fixed. Impairment is subject to the allowance-stock floor.

fx.method: The Bank does not disclose a separate net monetary FX position in the summary statements used, so no incremental FX translation P&L is modelled; the balance sheet is not revalued by currency. Flagged rather than guessed.
fx.reason: Avoid inventing a currency split that is not in the sources.

cash_reserve.method: Proxy required reserve = scenario CRR x year-end customer deposits. Cash and BoG balances include non-eligible cash, so this is a liquidity screening test, not regulatory compliance.

model_structure.method: Hold non-core balance sheet lines proportional to deposit growth, except property/other assets grow with opex; stated capital and other reserves held constant; non-pledged and pledged trading assets and investment securities follow deposit growth; cash balances plug the accounting identity, flagging negative balances or a reserve shortfall without automatically borrowing. RWA = gross loans + FY2025 calibrated residual risk intensity x (total assets minus gross loans). Q3 regulatory capital anchored on reported CAR x estimated RWA; Tier 1 capital anchored using the FY2025 Tier 1 / total regulatory capital relationship. Retained profit increments regulatory capital; dividends constrained to pre-dividend cash and the CAR buffer. Report a proxy, not a regulatory return.
model_structure.q4_opex_balance_growth: Annual opex growth divided by four for Q4 property and other assets.
model_structure.allowance_bridge: Implied write-offs/other reductions = opening allowance + modelled impairment - closing allowance; the impairment floor is max(risk-based charge, allowance stock increase, zero). Movements are scenario estimates, not observed write-offs. FY2026 opening allowance is estimated; Q4 only.
model_structure.cash_residual: Do not hide negative cash; show the reserve and funding gap. Cash is the reported cash-and-BoG aggregate, so regulatory compliance is not established.

notes: All numeric driver assumptions are analyst estimates, not reported bank results or management guidance.
2026 income must retain reported 9M results plus separately estimated Q4; model checks must flag any liquidity or capital shortfall.
Shared macro v1 numeric paths are used. Regulatory minimum CAR of 13.0% is quoted in the Bank of Ghana September 2026 Monetary Policy Report; not re-derived here.
Stanbic Bank Ghana is a Bank (separate) model; Standard Bank Group figures are never mixed in.
The Bank reports an indirect tax line above the direct income tax; the model forecasts total `income_tax` (indirect + direct) and splits 3% of PBT to x_indirect_tax.

macro_snapshot.note: Use all three shared scenarios; rerun after macro revisions. A missing required driver is a hard error.
